title: Akola Nagar Parishad Recruitment 2026 for Junior Clerk, Driver, Peon & Other Posts
salary_range: Rs. 15,000 - 81,900 (Pay Matrix Levels S-1 to S-8)
application_fee: Rs. 1000 for General/Open category, Rs. 900 for Reserved categories, and free for Ex-Servicemen.
age_limit: Generally 18 to 38 years for Open category and 18 to 43 years for Reserved/EWS categories (varies by post and category relaxation).
summary: Akola Nagar Parishad has announced a recruitment notification for 103 vacancies across various Group C and Group D posts including Junior Clerk, Stenographer, Driver, Electrician, Peon, and others. Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official Akola district website between November 26, 2026, and December 17, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Must hold a minimum educational qualification ranging from 10th Pass, ITI/Diploma, to Graduation/Post Graduation depending on the specific post.
Must possess proficiency in the Marathi language.
Age limits range from 18 to 38 years for unreserved candidates, with upper age relaxations for reserved category candidates as per Maharashtra government rules.
Candidates claiming reservation or age relaxations must possess valid relevant certificates such as Domicile, Caste Certificate, and Non-Creamy Layer certificates.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Junior Clerk / Clerk-Typist (कनिष्ठ लिपिक / लिपिक टंकलेखक)

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official website at akola.gov.in.
Review the detailed notification, eligibility criteria, and instructions carefully before applying.
Access the online application portal and fill out the required candidate details.
Upload scanned copies of required certificates including educational mark sheets, identity proof, caste certificate, non-creamy layer, and photo/signature in specified formats.
Pay the applicable non-refundable application fee online.
Submit the final application form and print a copy for future reference.

fee_structure.category: Reserved Categories / EWS / Orphan (राखीव प्रवर्ग / मागास प्रवर्ग / आ.दु.घ.)

pay_level: Pay Matrix Levels S-1 to S-8
